  When you are done, confirm that `answer.xyz` exists in the working directory.

args.command:

from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem, Draw, rdMolDescriptors

inchi = ("InChI=1S/C21H22N2O2/c24-18-10-16-19-13-9-17-21(6-7-22(17)11-12(13)5-8-25-16)"
         "15-3-1-2-4-14(15)23(18)20(19)21/h1-5,13,16-17,19-20H,6-11H2/t13-,16-,17-,19-,20-,21+/m0/s1")
m = Chem.MolFromInChI(inchi)
assert m is not None, "InChI parse failed"
m = Chem.AddHs(m)
print("formula:", rdMolDescriptors.CalcMolFormula(m))
print("atoms:", m.GetNumAtoms())
print("stereo centers:", Chem.FindMolChiralCenters(m, includeUnassigned=True, useLegacyImplementation=False))

# 2D depiction for stereochemistry comparison (compute 2D coords preserving chirality)
m2 = Chem.RemoveHs(m)
AllChem.Compute2DCoords(m2)
Draw.MolToFile(m2, "depict.png", size=(760,680), kekulize=True)

# 3D embed (ETKDGv3) + MMFF optimize
params = AllChem.ETKDGv3()
params.randomSeed = 42
params.useRandomCoords = True
cid = AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m, params)
print("embed cid:", cid)
AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(m, mmffVariant="MMFF94s", maxIters=2000)
Chem.MolToXYZFile(m, "initial.xyz")
print("wrote initial.xyz")
EOF

from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem, Draw, rdMolDescriptors

# atoms 1..25 : C 1-21, N 22,23, O 24,25  -> rdkit index = n-1
els = {**{i:'C' for i in range(1,22)}, 22:'N',23:'N',24:'O',25:'O'}
rw = Chem.RWMol()
for n in range(1,26):
    a = Chem.Atom(els[n]); rw.AddAtom(a)
S=Chem.BondType.SINGLE; D=Chem.BondType.DOUBLE; A=Chem.BondType.AROMATIC
single=[(18,10),(10,16),(16,19),(19,13),(13,9),(9,17),(17,21),
        (21,6),(6,7),(7,22),(22,17),(22,11),(11,12),(12,13),
        (5,8),(8,25),(25,16),(21,15),(14,23),(23,18),(23,20),(20,19),(20,21)]
double=[(24,18),(12,5)]
arom=[(15,3),(3,1),(1,2),(2,4),(4,14),(14,15)]
for i,j in single: rw.AddBond(i-1,j-1,S)
for i,j in double: rw.AddBond(i-1,j-1,D)
for i,j in arom:  rw.AddBond(i-1,j-1,A)
for n in (1,2,3,4,14,15): rw.GetAtomWithIdx(n-1).SetIsAromatic(True)
m = rw.GetMol()
Chem.SanitizeMol(m, Chem.SanitizeFlags.SANITIZE_ALL)
mh = Chem.AddHs(m)
print("formula:", rdMolDescriptors.CalcMolFormula(mh), "heavy:", m.GetNumAtoms())
# achiral inchi (no stereo yet)
print("inchi:", Chem.MolToInchi(m))
AllChem.Compute2DCoords(m)
Draw.MolToFile(m,"dep2.png",size=(780,700))
Chem.MolToSmiles(m, True)

Now I'll enumerate the tetrahedral stereoisomers and select the one whose InChI stereo layers match natural strychnine (`/t13-,16-,17-,19-,20-,21+/m0/s1`), then embed and optimize.

args.command:
cat > stereo.py <<'EOF'
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem, Draw, rdMolDescriptors
from rdkit.Chem.EnumerateStereoisomers import EnumerateStereoisomers, StereoEnumerationOptions

m0 = Chem.MolFromSmiles("O=C1CC2OCC=C3CN4CCC56c7ccccc7N1C5C2C3CC46")
base = Chem.MolToInchi(m0)
target = base + "/t13-,16-,17-,19-,20-,21+/m0/s1"
print("base :", base)
print("target:", target)

opts = StereoEnumerationOptions(onlyStereoAtoms=True, unique=True)
match=None; n=0
for iso in EnumerateStereoisomers(m0, options=opts):
    n+=1
    if Chem.MolToInchi(iso) == target:
        match = iso; break
print("enumerated:", n, "match:", match is not None)
if match is None:
    # fallback: report closest (same /m and count of matching centers)
    for iso in EnumerateStereoisomers(m0, options=opts):
        inc = Chem.MolToInchi(iso)
        if inc.endswith("/m0/s1"):
            print("cand:", inc); 
    raise SystemExit
sm = Chem.MolToSmiles(match, True)
print("ISOMERIC SMILES:", sm)
print("centers:", Chem.FindMolChiralCenters(match, includeUnassigned=True, useLegacyImplementation=False))
# 2D depiction with wedges
m2 = Chem.Mol(match); AllChem.Compute2DCoords(m2)
Draw.MolToFile(m2,"dep_chiral.png",size=(780,700))
# embed with chirality enforced + MMFF
mh = Chem.AddHs(match)
p = AllChem.ETKDGv3(); p.randomSeed=7; p.useRandomCoords=True; p.enforceChirality=True
cid = AllChem.EmbedMolecule(mh, p); print("embed:", cid)
AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(mh, mmffVariant="MMFF94s", maxIters=3000)
Chem.MolToXYZFile(mh,"initial.xyz")
print("wrote initial.xyz atoms:", mh.GetNumAtoms())
EOF

args.command:
cat > verify.py <<'EOF'
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import rdMolDescriptors
# read optimized xyz
lines = open("answer.xyz").read().splitlines()
n = int(lines[0]); print("header atoms:", n, "| comment:", lines[1])
xyz = "\n".join(lines[2:2+n])
m_xyz = Chem.MolFromXYZBlock(xyz)
print("parsed atoms:", m_xyz.GetNumAtoms(), "formula:", rdMolDescriptors.CalcMolFormula(m_xyz))
# reference chiral mol (H-added), same atom order as initial.xyz used for xtb
ref = Chem.AddHs(Chem.MolFromSmiles("O=C1C[C@@H]2OCC=C3CN4CC[C@]56c7ccccc7N1[C@H]5[C@H]2[C@H]3C[C@H]46"))
assert ref.GetNumAtoms()==n
conf = m_xyz.GetConformer()
ref.RemoveAllConformers()
ref.AddConformer(Chem.Conformer(conf), assignId=True)
# assign stereo from 3D and compare inchi to natural strychnine target
heavy = Chem.RemoveHs(ref)
Chem.AssignStereochemistryFrom3D(heavy)
base = "InChI=1S/C21H22N2O2/c24-18-10-16-19-13-9-17-21(6-7-22(17)11-12(13)5-8-25-16)14-3-1-2-4-15(14)23(18)20(19)21/h1-5,13,16-17,19-20H,6-11H2"
target = base + "/t13-,16-,17-,19-,20-,21+/m0/s1"
got = Chem.MolToInchi(heavy)
print("stereo preserved (InChI match):", got==target)
print("centers:", Chem.FindMolChiralCenters(heavy, includeUnassigned=True, useLegacyImplementation=False))
# geometry sanity
import math
def dist(a,b):
    pa=conf.GetAtomPosition(a); pb=conf.GetAtomPosition(b)
    return math.dist((pa.x,pa.y,pa.z),(pb.x,pb.y,pb.z))
# find C=O: in ref, atom for carbonyl. Use substructure
co = ref.GetSubstructMatch(Chem.MolFromSmarts("[CX3]=[OX1]"))
print("C=O length:", round(dist(co[0],co[1]),3))
# min interatomic distance among nonbonded heavy atoms (clash check)
mind=9
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(i+1,n):
        if ref.GetBondBetweenAtoms(i,j): continue
        d=dist(i,j)
        if d<mind: mind=d; pair=(i,j)
print("min nonbonded distance:", round(mind,3), "atoms", pair)
EOF
